trigger: entering the City, first Voss meeting
note: Same format as awakening.json. No text in images; subtitles in the lower fifth. ~6-8 s per panel, 0.8 s crossfade.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The City. UEC banners hang over streets the colony built before it learned to be afraid.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Commander Voss is waiting. He does not look like a man who bluffs.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Dr. Osei. You've woken something that should have stayed asleep.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Station Seven went dark when a lattice like hers woke. Three hundred people. I buried the reports myself.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Hand over every fragment. Walk away. Keep your clearance.

lines.speaker: KAELA
lines.text: She was never asleep. You just weren't listening.

lines.speaker: KAELA
lines.text: If you're afraid of her, help me understand her. Don't erase her.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Then you are classified hostile. The drones will find you.
